title: Shiraishi An — We're About To Open!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Phew... Things are finally starting to calm down.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, I know our lunch service isn't over yet, but mind if I duck out for a bit?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's that too, but I was hoping to work on some things on my own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That video proved how amazing Dad and everyone else were.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We're nowhere near where we need to be to surpass that night. That means we have to try even harder moving forward...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Dad!
I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I should be able to sing at full volume from the start...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I feel good.
I'm modulating my voice better now compared to during practice yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(This still isn't enough.
Kohane sang even better that time.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I need to find a way to be able to sing like that...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to get the crowd's attention and make it so they can't look away in a split second...!!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was good. You sang with so much power just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Miku...! Why didn't you say you were here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because I didn't want to break your concentration by interrupting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I take it that watching that video of RAD WEEKEND has been a boon for you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, Miku, can I ask you more about how I sang just now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is there anything you feel I should fix? Anything I can immediately improve upon?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like I said, you sang with a lot of power just now, which is very you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You also modulated your voice well while going high and low, so I'm looking forward to seeing how you sing with the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, but... Isn't there anything I need to work on?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not as far as I could tell based on the part I did get to hear.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, it's just... I haven't been able to reach the level Kohane was at when she sang the other day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's good that you want to see what she saw.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However... Kohane's been practicing as per usual on top of working with Taiga, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which leads me to believe that only focusing on her in that particular moment isn't necessarily a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We came here expecting to see how you've progressed since you started working with Taiga, but to see this kind of change...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's as if you somehow put yourself into that video.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you think actually seeing how everything looked from the stage has anything to do with it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
From the stage?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, when I was practicing with Taiga...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see your point. Kohane's trying to make it so her practices with Uncle Taiga launch her forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can't help but look back on the way she sang back there...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But Miku's right. I shouldn't let that shackle me in any way.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
At the same time...
What can I do to reach her level?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Who knows?
That may be a case of pure trial and error.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be happy to help with any ideas you come up with, but how you want to progress will be entirely up to you, An.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you later.
Good luck with practice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have no idea what the right answer is, but I need to start somewhere!)
